description.narrative: Increased access to finance for MSMEs, including women borrowers: IFC expects that the proposed investment will increase access to finance for underserved micro enterprises and self-employed borrowers/microentrepreneurs including women borrowers. Competitiveness: IFC anticipates that the Project will promote greater competitiveness in the NBFC sector by encouraging NBFCs to grow their MSME portfolios, especially to underserved, harder-to-reach segments like microenterprises, self-employed individuals, and women borrowers, in small towns and rural areas.

The Project comprises of a US$ denominated, senior secured loan of up to US$50 million in Finova Capital Private Limited (Finova or the Company) for a tenure of 4 years in one or more tranches. The Company will utilize IFCs investment proceeds for growing its loan book towards micro and small enterprises (MSEs) and self-employed borrowers/ microentrepreneurs, including women borrowers and agricultural segment including dairy.
